_about: Public-domain John Scott (1639-1695), rector of St Giles in the Fields, for the Word Hoard: The Christian Life, from its beginning to its consummation in glory (London: Knapton and others, 1757, five volumes), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 45 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
